title: Require Service Module Isolation
forbids: a root-to-module edge outside contract and router composition, a module runtime reach into the root service, a two-level parent escape from module source, a root re-export of module implementation, or a current-owner sibling-module edge
why: The service composes modules from above while each module remains locally understandable: module.ts receives only the service context type, named routers may reach their own module and model, and runtime capability travels through context rather than upward imports.
remediate: Keep root imports to module contracts, completed routers, and provideContext boundaries. In module.ts, import the root Context only as a type and create the module implementer locally. Use one parent hop only within the same module, and move sibling collaboration behind a service-owned capability.
message: Service modules must use the canonical import surface and remain closed to sibling implementation.
